snippet.title: Die Hard Trilogy With a Vengeance Walkthrough: Harlem #1 (PS1)
snippet.description:
Hmm, you may be surprised why a Nintendo guy is uploading this, but that's because no-one uploaded a PS1 walkthrough of this game before. Now, maybe I should tell more about this game:

-The objective of this game, is to somewhat defuse various 'bombs' around the area, by running into it. There's always a time limit for each bomb, and if you don't make it time, BOOM. Mass destruction, and you lose a life. It can be hard, luckily there is a red arrow, which points you to the bomb. Defuse all the bombs in the level, and you get to proceed to the next level.

-You may have seen blue arrows in the compass. They lead you to new cars. Some levels has lots of them, some have a few, and some have none at all. Each car varies in performance. I don't go to them often, since they reset your turbo back to 3.

-You will encounter many pickups in this level. This level introduces the following pick ups.
-Time: Pick this up, and the time limit before the bomb explodes increases. Very good if you don't want to lose. They are easy to grab since they are common and have a large grab range.
-Turbo: Adds one turbo to your total. in which you can press the Circle button to get a boost. Good, if you're running out of time and want to smash through roadblocks.
-Points: Increases your score. Your final score is determined at the end of the last level, so you may want to pick these up before you get there. They're not that important though.
-EMS: Summons an ambulance, that will drive through a specific route. They are useful as they can clear out traffic jams. They can also lead you to a special route, or the best way to reach a bomb. PS: In the game, there is ONE EMS pickup in the whole game, that summons a Police Car instead of an Ambulance. I don't know where it is located though.

There is always a Bomb Car in every level. Bomb cars are cars that move around, and will explode after a short period of time. You'll need to hit it a couple of times to destroy and defuse it. Sometimes they are friendly enough to give you a Time pickup.
Every level you finish, you get some bonus points for doing these things they are:
-Safety Margin: How safe you drove. The more safe you drive, the more points you will get, whereas in the other hand, drving like a madman, won't score you this bonus.
-Citizens Saved: How many Citizens are alive at the end of the level. In the game, running over a citizen will cause you to lose points and cause this bonus to decrease. Interestingly, using a horn will get them out of the way, and if you get a Game Over, you will not receive this bonus, since everyone died because of the bombs.
-Car Damage: The condition of the car that finished the level. Damage is caused by hitting walls and even objects such as other cars.The less damage the more points. To keep this bonus up, switch to a new car before you finish a level.

These are the playable cars in this level:
-2 Taxis (One can be used at the start of the level)
-3 Cop Cars
-3 Murray Trucks
-1 Light Blue Sedan
-1 Black Sedan (The one that I used)

So there you go. I know the quality is terrible, but this is a PS1 game. This is only the first level in the game.
